# Extract the host and guest judge columns for series one to eight
hosts_series = df.loc[df['Series'].isin(['One', 'Two', 'Three', 'Four', 'Five', 'Six', 'Seven', 'Eight']), 'Host(s)']
guests_series = df.loc[df['Series'].isin(['One', 'Two', 'Three', 'Four', 'Five', 'Six', 'Seven', 'Eight']), 'Guest judge(s)']

# Combine all judges from both columns
all_judges = []
for host in hosts_series:
    if isinstance(host, str):
        judges = host.split('\n')
        all_judges.extend(judges)
for guest in guests_series:
    if isinstance(guest, str) and guest != 'N/A':
        judges = guest.split('\n')
        all_judges.extend(judges)

# Remove duplicates and count unique judges
unique_judges = set(all_judges)
answer = len(unique_judges)
